# HESPOR Funding (funding.hespor.com)

> HESPOR Trading Ltd. is a Canadian company based in Burnaby, British Columbia. It is an independent introducer, not a lender, that connects Canadian small businesses with fast business funding of $5,000 to $1,000,000 from its lending partner, an alternative business lender in Vancouver. Service is available in English and Persian (Farsi).

## Key facts
- Company: HESPOR Trading Ltd., 170-422 Richards St, Vancouver, BC V6B 2Z4, Canada. Email: info@hespor.com.
- Role: independent introducer (referral partner). HESPOR does not lend money, make credit decisions or hold client funds.
- Lender: HESPOR's lending partner, an alternative business lender in Vancouver, reviews every application, decides on approval and sets all terms. It has funded more than 10,000 businesses and deployed over $800 million.
- Cost of HESPOR's service to the business owner: none. HESPOR's referral commission is paid by the lender and is never added to the client's cost.
- Products: business loans (term financing) from $5,000 to $1,000,000 over 6 to 24 months; merchant cash advances; revolving business lines of credit from $7,500 to $125,000.
- Minimum requirements: business located in Canada, at least 6 months in operation, at least $10,000 in average monthly revenue. Meeting the minimums does not guarantee approval.
- Speed: same-business-day introduction to the lender; decisions in as little as 1 business day; funds as fast as 24 hours after approval; most businesses finish within a week.
- What is needed: basic business details and a secure connection to the business bank account so the lender can review revenue. No business plan required.
- Repayment: automatic daily or weekly payments from the business bank account, or a percentage of card sales, depending on the product.
- Pricing for business loans and merchant cash advances: a factor rate (typically 1.10 to 1.50), not an interest rate. Total repayment = amount funded x factor rate, fixed upfront. Example: $50,000 at 1.20 = $60,000 total, the same whether repaid over 6, 12 or 24 months.
- Honest cost note: fast funding costs more than a bank loan; it suits businesses that need speed or were declined by a bank.
- Geography: businesses anywhere in Canada, including Vancouver, Toronto, Calgary, Edmonton, Montreal and Ottawa. US businesses are not currently eligible.
- Industries: restaurants and cafés, retail, grocery and wholesale, importers and distributors, auto repair, salons and spas, construction and trades, e-commerce, professional services, medical and dental clinics, manufacturing, transportation.

## Contact
Request funding options at https://funding.hespor.com/apply/ or email info@hespor.com. HESPOR replies within one business day.

Disclosure: HESPOR Trading Ltd. is not a lender. Financing is provided by our lending partner. Approval and terms are subject to the lender's review.
